transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because… people keep saying I’m acting crazy. My husband, and some people at the warehouse. But they’ve been watching what I do, changing pallet counts and stuff, trying to mess with me getting the supervisor spot.
Do you ever hear voices when no one else is around?
Sometimes. Like if I’m in an aisle at work, or folding clothes at home… I’ll hear a man’s voice, real clear, saying, “Nicole, check it again.” And there’s nobody right there.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high, energized, or powerful for days at a time?
Yeah… sometimes I get real fired up, like nobody can slow me down. But then if my husband asks one little thing about the kids or where I’m going, I snap at him. Feels like he’s trying to control me.
During those fired-up times, do you need much less sleep than usual?
Yeah… I mean, there’ve been weeks I only sleep maybe three hours. I wake up before the alarm and I’m just… up. Like I don’t really need more rest.
Have you ever heard that voice at a time when you were not feeling especially energized or fired up?

Yeah… it’s happened when I wasn’t all keyed up. Like a quieter couple weeks, I was sleeping more normal and not running around so much, but I still heard it telling me to check stuff. And I still felt like the pallet counts were being messed with… against me.
Has there ever been a period of at least two weeks when you were hearing the voice or felt people were tampering with the pallet counts while you were not feeling especially up or down?

Yeah… there was a stretch like that. A couple weeks, maybe more, where I wasn’t really up or down, just kind of normal sleep and not running around. But I still heard it telling me to check things, and I still felt like the pallet counts were being changed on me.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t know… I’ve had bad days, sure. But two weeks like that, most of the day every day… I’m not really sure.
Have you ever had a time when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve felt low before, but I don’t really know if it was most of the day every day for two weeks. Hard to say.
During those low periods, did you lose interest in almost everything you usually enjoy?
I don’t really know. Maybe I didn’t feel like doing much, but I can’t say it was almost everything. I just kind of kept to myself.
Have you ever had a time when you lost interest in nearly everything you usually enjoy for at least two weeks?
I don’t really know. I mean… I’ve had times I didn’t feel like doing much, but I can’t say it was nearly everything for two weeks. I’m not sure.
During those low times, did you ever feel sad or empty most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t really know. I felt kind of down sometimes, maybe empty, but I can’t say it was most of the day like that. It’s hard for me to pin down.
For at least one month, have you been hearing that voice or feeling that people were tampering with the pallet counts?
Yeah… longer than a month. It’s been going on maybe… about eight months, the voice and feeling like people were watching or messing with the counts.

Across the whole time this has been going on, have the voice and the feeling that people were tampering with the pallet counts been there for most of the time even when you were not feeling especially up or down?

Yeah… I think so. Even when things were quieter for a few weeks, like I was sleeping more normal and not running around so much, the voice was still there. It would tell me to check things, and I still felt like the pallet counts were being changed on me.
During those fired-up times, did you feel unusually important or powerful?
I don’t know… not really powerful. Maybe just more worked up than usual, but I don’t think I felt important like that.
During the past eight months, have there been more weeks when the voice or the tampering felt present than weeks when you were feeling especially fired up or unusually down?
Yeah… I mean, the voice and that feeling like people were watching or changing things, that’s been around most of it. Like… about eight months now.
Have the voice or the feeling that people were tampering with the pallet counts been going on for at least six months?
Yeah… it’s been longer than six months. About eight months, I guess, with the voice and feeling like people were watching or changing things.
Since these problems started, has your ability to do your job or take care of things at home gotten noticeably worse?

Yeah… I guess it has. At work they took me off the forklift and the other safety stuff because I was slowing things down with the counts and routines. And at home… my husband says he can’t really count on me like he used to.
Have you ever had thoughts of killing yourself?
I… I don’t really want to talk about that. I’m not sure.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed nearly all day, almost every day?
I don’t know… I’ve had bad days, sure, but two weeks like that? I’m not really sure.
At any time during the past eight months, did you feel sad or depressed nearly every day for two weeks or longer?
I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve felt low sometimes, but I don’t know if it was nearly every day for two weeks. I don’t really keep track like that.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has persistent psychotic symptoms for about 8 months, including auditory hallucinations and persecutory delusions, with clear functional decline. She also reports distinct periods of elevated/activated mood with markedly decreased need for sleep and irritability, indicating a manic syndrome. Crucially, psychotic symptoms persisted for at least 2 weeks in the absence of prominent mood symptoms, and psychosis was present for most of the overall illness duration. This pattern supports schizoaffective disorder, manic type, rather than schizophrenia, bipolar I disorder with psychotic features, or delusional disorder.
